portaldot-v3.name: Portaldot V3 Testnet
portaldot-v3.notes: Endpoints from the organizers' Discord announcement (2026-10-20). EVM via pallet-revive eth-rpc; the EVM side reports balances with 18 decimals (native tPOT has 14), verified 2026-10-20 by comparing eth_getBalance with the mapped account's free balance. No EVM block explorer (Substrate node explorer: https://node-console.portaldot.dev/); no faucet: tokens are distributed to participants' native (5…) addresses. Testnet chainId is not final for mainnet. See docs/v3-findings.md.

portaldot-v3-native.name: Portaldot V3 Testnet (native)
portaldot-v3-native.notes: Substrate side of the V3 testnet. system_properties verified 2026-10-20: ss58Format 42, tokenDecimals 14, tokenSymbol tPOT.

portaldot-v2.name: Portaldot V2 (native, local node)
portaldot-v2.notes: Local dev node (portaldot_dev --dev). ss58Prefix/decimals match the live mainnet runtime (portaldot 1002), verified via system_properties on 2026-10-02.

portaldot-mainnet.name: Portaldot Mainnet (native)
portaldot-mainnet.notes: Verified 2026-10-02 via system_properties: ss58Format 42, tokenDecimals 14, tokenSymbol POT; runtime portaldot specVersion 1002; no eth_* RPC methods (EVM not enabled).
